details: When trying to change into the legacy avatar Robot by Vrchat, the avatar loads in as an error robot. I have deleted and reinstalled all of the gamefiles, restarted my PC clear all cache, cleared local data, reset all profile data, verified my connection, restarted my router, unplugged it and let it fully reset, I have tried changing accounts and the same problem occurs. Here is the only message I could find in the logs that seems to be related to the problem :[Behaviour] Error downloading avatar Robot/Security: Error loading asset bundle from **: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden I have asked the ai support about this error and it seems like the message states that the avatar download is being blocked. when I made a support request I was sent a bunch of stuff about connection issues and make IPV4 priority but as mentioned above that did not work. I am pretty much out of solutions here if anyone knows anything (!!!!***not about connection issues***!!!!!) well let me know. Thanks //Edit: this issue is Local only meaning that other player see me as the Legacy Robot by Vrchat.
title: Error downloading avatar
